content.text: Updated: Mar. 24, 2026, 1:02 p.m.Published: Mar. 24, 2026, 1:01 p.m.Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special on Disney+/HuluHannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special on Disney+/HuluIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.The “Hannah Montana” 20th Anniversary Special is an hour-long special revisiting the classic Disney Channel TV series.You can watch it all on Disney+ and Hulu.In the special, Miley Cyrus dons the classic blonde wig, revisits recreations of some of the show’s most recognizable sets, performs the show’s most iconic songs, and chats with Alex Cooper of the “Call Her Daddy” podcast. Cyrus’s father, Billy Ray Cyrus, and fellow Disney Channel alumnus Selena Gomez will also make appearances. However, it is important to note that this is not a true reunion or revival. It is more of a nostalgic look back at the original series.The special even features new behind-the-scenes footage, making it unmissable for original fans of the series.Because the event is releasing exclusively on Disney+, we recommend that, when you sign up to watch, you bundle the service with Hulu and HBO Max for shockingly cheap.
